why: A sweep's worth is the output it denies, not the escort it must beat, and it casts no more than our spawns land: one harasser at a time (`askedMost`), new sweeps opening only within our spawns' share (`sweep::room_for`). Our bot in two seats, each the other's enemy. On 04674305 beta's RCL3 sweep of E8S7, priced against alpha's whole army (escort 24), asked 38 bodies (26.6k energy) its one spawn never landed; there alpha's sweeps asked 10-26 at once on every seed 1-5
